item.title: Installing ChatGPT Desktop on Mint 20 / Ubuntu 20.04 — when the blocker isn't glibc
item.author: william
item.description:
OpenAI shipped an official ChatGPT Desktop for Linux in August 2026 (preview), supporting Ubuntu 24.04/26.04, Debian 13, Fedora 43/44 and Arch. Mint 20.3 (focal, glibc 2.31) is nowhere on that list, so I expected a rerun of the Claude Desktop surgery.

It wasn’t. The glibc floor was fine all along — the package is blocked by three library renames and one optional TPM module. The fix is smaller, and the audit is worth showing because the conclusion is the opposite of last time.

item.title: Installing Claude Desktop on Ubuntu 20.04 / Mint 20 (glibc 2.31)
item.author: william
item.description: Anthropic’s official Claude Desktop .deb declares libc6 (>= 2.34), which means Ubuntu 22.04+ / Mint 21+. On Mint 20.3 (focal, glibc 2.31) apt refuses to install it. It turns out that dependency is an overstatement, and the app runs fine on glibc 2.31 once you know which three files actually need 2.34.

item.title: nvim tree input completion
item.author: william
item.description:
nvim-tree 删除/垃圾箱确认提示中禁用 blink-cmp 自动补全

问题

在 nvim-tree 中执行 Remove/Trash 操作时，dressing.nvim 会弹出确认对话框（DressingInput buffer，filetype = "DressingInput"）。用户输入 y/n 时，blink-cmp 会在这个 buffer 中触发自动补全，干扰确认操作。

item.title: reasonix: D-Bus依赖
item.author: william
item.description:
Reasonix 启动卡死问题排查与修复

症状

执行 reasonix 命令行后终端卡死，无法正常启动。reasonix --help 可以正常输出，但 reasonix doctor、交互式会话等操作均会永久挂起。
